content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have cystic fibrosis documented?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, invalid_reason
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cystic fibrosis%'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, vocabulary_id, concept_name
LIMIT 25;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 441267;
